features: 3MP HD Resolution for Clear Surveillance The camera features advanced 3MP HD video quality that delivers sharp, detailed, and crystal-clear footage for effective monitoring. Enhanced image clarity helps capture faces, movement, and activities accurately for improved security management.

4G SIM Based Connectivity for Remote Monitoring Equipped with 4G SIM support, the camera operates without requiring WiFi or broadband connection. Simply insert a compatible SIM card for uninterrupted remote monitoring in homes, farms, warehouses, shops, offices, construction sites, and remote locations.

All Time Colour Night Vision Technology The advanced All Time Colour Night Vision captures vivid full-colour footage even during low-light and nighttime conditions. Unlike traditional infrared cameras, it provides better scene visibility and improved image details throughout the night.

Two-Way Audio Communication The built-in microphone and speaker support seamless Two-Way Audio communication, allowing users to listen and speak remotely through the mobile app. Ideal for visitor interaction, staff communication, home monitoring, and security management.

Supports Up to 256GB Memory Card Storage The camera supports memory card storage up to 256GB for continuous recording and playback access. Cloud storage compatibility provides additional backup security and remote video access anytime from anywhere.

Smart Mobile App Monitoring Users can access live view, playback recordings, receive motion alerts, and manage camera settings remotely through Android & iOS mobile applications for convenient surveillance control.

STQC Approved Smart Security Camera The camera is BIS-ER STQC Approved, ensuring quality compliance, reliable performance, and trusted security standards suitable for modern surveillance requirements.
